description: FLOW construct distribution for the synthetic EAI corpus. Measured from 2 webMethods interfaces / 6 FLOW services in the sample described in docs/PLAN-EAI.md. Two interfaces is a small sample, so ratios are used as design targets rather than as statistically firm rates - see the note on scale below.
scale_note: The sampled interfaces map 39-column tables; the virtual schema here is narrower, so absolute MAPCOPY counts per interface are lower. Field-proportional constructs are therefore held to a ratio against MAPCOPY, while structural constructs (INVOKE, SEQUENCE, BRANCH, LOOP) scale with the number of FLOW services instead - they exist per step block, not per mapped field, and holding them to a MAPCOPY ratio would wrongly shrink them on a narrow schema.
